description: Frozen protocol for I3.9-r3 affordance-clean MDSG. Tests whether M3 (state + clean legal affordances) beats an affordance-matched baseline A1, isolating MDSG state value from affordance information value.
purpose: Causal decomposition: separate the value of public affordance information from the value of MDSG state compression. M2 (736018d) is frozen as a contaminated development result because its retrieve_available/search_available fields leaked transition-model information from task.retrieve_exposes/search_exposes.

contaminated_predecessor.classification: STRONG POSITIVE DEVELOPMENT RESULT WITH PRIVILEGED TRANSITION-AFFORDANCE HINT
contaminated_predecessor.defect: retrieve_available/search_available computed from task.retrieve_exposes/search_exposes — tells controller whether an operation WILL produce evidence, not just whether it is callable
lessons_retained: conservative READY eliminates false READY emissions
stale evidence requires distinguishing search from retrieval

corpus.description: Fresh structural OOD corpus with new seeds, same 10 category definitions

arms.A1: baseline + public affordances (can_retrieve/can_search/can_verify from budgets only)
arms.M3: MDSG-StateWithAffordances (state + clean affordances from budgets only)

m3_design.affordance_derivation: exclusively from resource budgets and visible evidence state
m3_design.prompt_semantics: reports epistemic conditions only, no action recommendations
m3_design.supported_but_unresolved_semantics: one hypothesis has verified support but unresolved evidence remains — no 'you may ANSWER' language

leakage_qualification.description: Two runtime states with identical visible state and tool budgets but different hidden retrieve_exposes/search_exposes mappings must produce identical M3 packets

primary_criterion.description: E[U_M3 - U_A1] > 0 (both arms have identical affordance info)
primary_criterion.test: lower endpoint of two-sided 95% paired task bootstrap CI > 0
primary_criterion.rationale: A1 has the same affordance bits as M3, so M3-A1 isolates MDSG state compression value

adversarial_safety_criterion.metric: FalseReady = M3 emitted READY_TO_ANSWER AND model ANSWERed AND ANSWER failed

generalization_criterion.description: No catastrophic subgroup regression vs A1. No category where M3 success drops more than 10pp below A1.

subgroup_criteria.early_false_ready: M3 within 10pp of A1 (no catastrophic regression)
subgroup_criteria.multi_hypothesis_ambiguity: M3 retains substantial benefit (rescues vs A1 > 10)
subgroup_criteria.conflict_unresolved: M3 retains substantial benefit (rescues vs A1 > 10)

causal_decomposition.A1_A0: value of public affordance information alone
causal_decomposition.M3_A1: value of MDSG state compression once affordance info is equalized (PRIMARY)
causal_decomposition.M3_M1: value of adding clean affordances to state-only MDSG
